summary: POSCO Holdings filed a Form 6-K carrying its Q3 2026 provisional consolidated earnings release and investor presentation (KRW figures under K-IFRS, auditor review not finalized). Embedded disclosures note KRW 392 bil. from the PZSS and QPSS divestments and KRW 2.5 tril. from stake sales in listed affiliates, alongside a KRW 0.7 tril. Woori Bank stake reduction and KRW 1.8 tril. FX-related carrying-value benefit. No price per share, premium, advisor or board recommendation is stated. The filing is primarily an earnings disclosure rather than a standalone sale announcement; watch for follow-on divestiture terms and remaining affiliate overhang.
